dataRights.schoolNote: Your school created this account. Deleting it also deletes your school's record of you. Your school is not asked to approve it.

section.title: Your data
section.intro: You can download a copy of the information we hold about you, and you can delete your account.
section.summaryFailed: We could not load a summary of your data.

categories.careerNarratives: Written explanations of your career matches

section.deleteBody: Deleting your account is permanent. Before anything is deleted, you will see what will be deleted and be asked to confirm.

export.what: The file holds the information we have about you. It is a data file made for other software, not a document to read, and it is in English.
export.rateLimited: You have downloaded your data too many times in the last hour. Try again later.
export.failed: The download did not work. Try again.

refusal.title: Your account cannot be deleted here
refusal.adminOf: You are the registered administrator of {{schools}}.
refusal.afterSchoolRemoval: Your account can be deleted after the school is removed from Future Pathways. Until then, the school's records name you as the person responsible for it, and deleting your account would destroy them.
refusal.intro: Your account holds records of things you did that are also part of other people's records. Deleting your account would destroy them:
refusal.unconfirmable: This account has no password or email address to confirm with, so it cannot be deleted here.

labels.school_administrator: School records naming you as the registered administrator
labels.school_activity_performed: School activity-log entries recording actions you performed
labels.school_activity_affected: School activity-log entries recording actions taken on your admin account

delete.loadFailed: We could not check your account. Nothing has been deleted. Reload the page to try again.

kept.school_removal_record: Your name stays in the activity log of {{school}}, the school you left. That entry records that you were removed from the school, and deleting your account does not remove it.
kept.consent_attestation: Your name and email address stay on the consent record you made for {{school}}. It is kept as evidence that consent was given.
kept.school_deletion_record: Your name and email address stay on the record that you deleted {{school}}.

delete.copyBody: Once your account is deleted, it cannot be recovered, and we cannot send you a copy later.
delete.confirmBody: Everything listed earlier will be deleted permanently, straight away.
delete.emailLabel: Type this account's email address to confirm

errors.passwordIncorrect: That password is not right. Nothing was deleted.
errors.emailMismatch: That email address does not match this account. Nothing was deleted.
errors.tooManyAttempts: Too many attempts. Try again later. Nothing was deleted.
errors.unreachable: We could not get an answer from the server, so we cannot tell whether your account was deleted. Reload this page to check.
errors.failed: Something went wrong, and nothing was deleted. Try again.

delete.doneBody: You have been signed out. Your account and everything listed earlier have been deleted.

progress.oneGradeDesc: Your Career Journey compares your results from one grade to the next. You have one grade recorded, so there is nothing to compare yet. Take the assessment again in a later grade and this page will show how your direction changes.
progress.consistencyDesc: Careers that appear consistently across your assessments
progress.gradeByGradeDesc: Your assessment history and top career matches by grade
progress.notCompleted: Assessment not yet completed for this grade

progress.mostConsistent: Your most consistent career interest is
progress.clarityDesc: {{count}} careers have appeared in at least half of your assessments, showing strong consistency in your career interests.
